jobs.description:
As an Industrial Integrator (m/w/d), this role combines product integration, industrial planning and cross-functional project coordination at the Hamburg-Finkenwerder site. The position offers responsibility for aligning manufacturing requirements, milestones and industrial deliverables across the relevant final assembly areas.

Your tasks:

- Identify, coordinate and track industrial requirements for product development projects across all relevant final assembly functions.
- Prepare and conduct Industrial Reviews in line with the Industrial Development Plan and the agreed project milestones.
- Define assembly concepts, manufacturing processes and production systems, while monitoring compliance throughout project execution.
- Coordinate interfaces between programme teams, local Value Stream Management, Industrial Architecture, Supply Chain, Procurement, Chief Engineering, Quality Assurance and serial production.
- Ensure that Engineering, Procurement, local Value Stream Management and other stakeholders provide complete and timely input for Industrial Development Plan and Product Development Plan reviews.
- Support Industrial Programme Leaders during higher-level project reviews and provide structured decision-making information.
- Conduct regular risk and opportunity assessments for manufacturing areas and integrate the results into overall project management and risk management activities.
- Maintain key project documentation, support complex industrial changes and lead lessons-learned reviews after major milestones to strengthen future processes.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Completed bachelor’s degree or higher in automotive engineering, engineering, aerospace, or another relevant technical discipline.
- Initial professional experience in product development, project management and industrialisation process management is expected; experience of more than two years in product development and industrialisation is advantageous.
- Experience of more than three years in project management is desirable, particularly in technically complex or cross-functional environments.
- Basic knowledge of change management and risk management, combined with an interest in structured industrial decision-making.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess dependencies, identify risks and drive clear follow-up actions.
- Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Procurement, Production and Quality functions.
- Business-fluent English is required; German and/or French language skills are advantageous.
- Experience with data analysis tools, such as Skywise or comparable applications, is beneficial. Familiarity with Google Workspace is expected.
- Willingness to travel internationally approximately four to five times per year.
- The position is planned as full-time employment with 35 hours per week.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 80.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

Corego is an event technology company powering large-scale events and festivals. Our seamless payment and access control solutions ensure smooth operations and effortless experiences for attendees and organizers alike. Combining technical innovation with deep industry expertise, we help bring ambitious live experiences to life.

Job Description

As a Data Engineer, you'll join a growing team and take on a substantial role in developing and operating Corego's data platform with real influence over development. You'll work closely with product management, software developers, and our existing data/analytics team. It's a chance to make a lasting mark on the technology behind some of Europe's biggest live events.

You'll take ownership of Corego's data platform on Databricks — developing it, keeping it running reliably, and growing it as our data and AI needs evolve. Day to day, this includes:

- Developing and evolving the platform's ingestion, lakehouse architecture, transformation pipelines, and orchestration
- Building and maintaining the data models and pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and machine learning workloads across Corego Cloud (payments, access control, network, POS)
- Maintaining strong data quality, testing, and CI/CD practices across the platform
- Defining and evolving access control, data governance, and security standards (e.g. Unity Catalog)

On the operations side, you'll:

- Run the platform in production — monitoring, incident response, and performance/cost optimization (cluster and compute management)
- Extend the platform with new data products, pipelines, and use cases as Corego's data and AI roadmap grows
- Collaborate with product management and developers to integrate data/ML outputs into business processes and customer-facing products
- Own data reliability and scalability as usage and event volumes grow

Requirements

- Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or another relevant technical field
- 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience designing and building data pipelines
- Practical experience with Databricks (or an equivalent Spark-based platform), including PySpark and workflow orchestration
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code and DevOps practices for data platforms
- Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure
- Understanding of data security and governance best practices
- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to manage your own workload
- Ability to work independently and take initiative, while fitting well within the team
- Proficiency in English

Considered an Advantage

- Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional (or equivalent certification)
- Familiarity with ML models and tooling
- Experience with API- and microservice-oriented architectures

Practical Information

This is a permanent*,* full-time position. Start date is flexible and will be discussed individually.

We are looking for a person based in the greater Hamburg area in Germany.

Why join us?

- Work with meaningful, growth-driven solutions — our technology powers seamless payment and access experiences for hundreds of thousands of people at some of Europe's most memorable live events, giving you a dynamic, forward-looking environment to build and grow in.
- Take on real ownership — you'll have genuine influence over how our data platform evolves, with the trust and space to shape decisions rather than just execute on them.
- Grow with an international team — you'll collaborate closely with experienced colleagues, contributing to Corego's international journey.
- Enjoy a culture that balances ambition and authenticity — we're professional, driven, and down-to-earth. We take our work seriously, without taking ourselves too seriously.

How to Apply

Apply for the position by sending us your CV and a short cover letter in PDF form via our career page. In your application, please let us know your availability, including your earliest possible start date and your salary expectations.

Please submit your application by 23 October 2026 at 23:59 EET. We actively review applications and interview candidates during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found. We therefore encourage you to apply as early as possible!

Questions about the recruitment process or the open position? Experiencing technical issues with the application system? Please contact us at niina.antila@corego.com or lara.henkes@corego.com .

We will keep all applicants informed about the progress of the process.

Please note that we only accept applications sent in English through the link below and do not accept applications sent through email.

jobs.occupation: Senior Regulatory Affairs Expert (all genders) Biocides (EU & GB) (Regulatory-Affairs-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Design a more beautiful world with us

Join the team behind the shimmer in cosmetics, the gleam in concept cars and the science that sparks innovation. At SUSONITY, we don’t just create materials – we bring beauty and performance to life. And we’re just getting started. As a global team of thinkers, makers and innovators, we’re united by a simple belief: that surfaces can do more than look good – they can perform brilliantly. Join us and help build the next generation of beauty, durability and design.

 The role

An exciting opportunity is available within our Product Compliance Department. As Senior Regulatory Affairs Expert for Biocides (EU & GB), you will coordinate and execute regulatory activities for our insect repellent business, with a primary focus on the EU Biocidal Products Regulation (BPR, Regulation (EU No 528/2012) and GB BPR. You will also contribute to registration projects across global markets.

Working closely with colleagues in Product Management, Sales and Product Development, you will help ensure that our portfolio meets regulatory requirements and remain fit for market. Following onboarding, you will act as a key regulatory contact for authorities, industry associations and customers. You will become part of a global team responsible for product compliance, sustainability and quality oversight across our portfolio.

Your responsibilities

- Coordinate and execute regulatory activities for the PT19 insect repellent business under the EU and GB BPR at active substance and biocidal product level, including authorisations, renewals, changes and other post-authorisation activities.
- Monitor and assess regulatory developments and their potential impact on our portfolio.
- Contribute to and coordinate regulatory registration projects across international markets.
- Act as a key regulatory contact for competent authorities, industry associations and customers.
- Work closely with global colleagues and cross-functional partners in Product Management, Sales and Product Development.
- Support the global team in ensuring product compliance, sustainability and quality oversight across SUSONITY’s portfolio.

Your profile

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in natural sciences, preferably with a background in toxicology.
- At least 7 years of professional experience in regulatory affairs under the EU BPR and practical knowledge working under the GB BPR. Professional experience with EU/GB BPR legislation and regulatory requirements, including regulatory procedures at active substance and biocidal product level.
- Experience with human health risk assessments and the interpretation of toxicological data in a regulatory context.
- Practical experience with dossier preparation in IUCLID and dossier submission in R4BP 3.
- Experience with SAP ERP software and document management systems is preferred.
- Strong customer orientation, self-motivation and a genuine interest in networking.
- Very good analytical and process-oriented thinking, combined with a structured, solution-oriented approach.
- Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, as well as proactive problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
- Ability to manage and deliver work in a matrix organisation and to collaborate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.
- Effective negotiation and presentation skills.
- Fluency in English, both written and spoken, and proficiency in at least one additional major European language.

 What we offer

At SUSONITY, you’ll have the opportunity to make a global impact — shaping the commercial foundation of a fast-evolving organization. We offer a culture that values empowerment, collaboration, and innovation, giving you the freedom to lead initiatives that drive real business success.

We support our colleagues in their development and promote an open and inclusive culture. We believe it's our duty to meet our fundamental responsibilities in topics like human rights, labor conditions and anti-corruption practices. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. People are responsible for the success of our organization, so people play an important role in all we do and how we achieve it.

Apply now and join the bright minds behind brilliant surfaces.

jobs.occupation: Director Client Success (Leiter/in - Key Account Management)
jobs.employer_name: Visa Europe Management Services German Branch Ltd.
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Client Success Director is a key leadership role with responsibility for both managing a portfolio of strategic client accounts and leading a team that delivers high-quality post-sale service and operational support. In this position, you will act as a play maker who balances direct client management with active team leadership.

You are accountable for the overall client experience. This includes working closely with senior client stakeholders to understand their business needs and ensure they receive ongoing value from our solutions. The role involves driving product adoption, supporting client growth and serving as the main advocate for client interests across different functions and regions.

You will also lead your team by setting clear direction and providing continuous support. You will foster a collaborative and high-performance culture and encourage professional growth. You will ensure that your team’s work aligns with Client Success strategies and help them navigate complex challenges in support of our clients.

This role provides an opportunity to contribute to our Client Success transformation. You will work with cross-functional partners to deliver strong outcomes for clients and support the ongoing development of your team. The Director Client Success reports to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations and is based in Frankfurt.

Responsibilities include:

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Client Success team. Set clear goals and expectations, provide regular feedback, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented culture
- Align your team’s work with the overall Client Success strategy. Inspire team members to embrace change, adopt best practices, and continuously grow their skills and expertise
- Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration within your team and across the wider Client Success organization
- Oversee your team’s client portfolios to ensure consistent, high-quality post-sale service and operational support
- Directly manage a portfolio of strategic client accounts. Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by acting as a proactive advisor and advocate
- Serve as the primary point of contact for your own clients, understanding their business strategies, operational goals, and priorities. Ensure their needs are met and that they realize ongoing value from Visa solutions
- Develop, execute, and monitor Client Success Plans for your own clients, in alignment with the Account Team. Track key outcomes including product adoption, performance, and satisfaction
- Oversee and support the implementation of new Visa products for both your own clients and those managed by your team. Coordinate with key client and Visa stakeholders to expedite readiness activities, maximize adoption, and deliver value—often across multiple geographies
- Guide your team in understanding client systems landscapes, integration points, and critical opportunities and challenges. Support them in identifying and addressing client needs that align with business growth
- Drive and deliver initiatives that improve client adoption of Visa products and promote the use of self-service tools. Monitor and report on health metrics for your own clients and those managed by your team.
- Serve as a thought leader on market trends, Visa solutions, and new technologies. Help both your team and your clients stay informed and ahead of industry developments.
- Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Client Services and other internal teams. Lead efforts to resolve complex client issues and optimize performance through effective collaboration.
- Share knowledge and insights regularly with colleagues across Client Success, Sales, Product, and other functions both for your own clients and more broadly within the market or region.
- Oversee and contribute to the development and delivery of client education and training, including webinars and communications on new Visa rules and business enhancements.
- Lead or participate in operational reviews with clients and internal stakeholders, including at an international level for global clients.
- Act as the escalation point for major issues and incidents for your own clients and those managed by your team. Provide guidance and support during crisis response and ensure effective resolution.
- Champion operational excellence by encouraging your team to support cross-functional initiatives and seek opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity.
- Proactively monitor client health and satisfaction for your own portfolio and your team’s. Identify opportunities to optimize performance and coordinate with specialist teams as needed.
- Lead key strategic initiatives that support the global Client Success transformation. Serve as a role model for change and continuous improvement within your team and for your own clients.
- Deliver operational resilience support by coordinating client communications and response during crisis events, ensuring client needs are addressed and escalations are managed according to established plans.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to extract and synthesize data into actionable business solutions and provide sound analysis
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and processes in clear business language tailored to the audience
- Proven experience coaching or mentoring team members for skill and career development, either informally or in a formal leadership role
- Prior people management experience required, ideally within a matrixed and multi-location environment
- Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines
- Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts and applications, and how they can create value for Visa and its clients
- Experience representing technical and business issues and solutions to influence various audiences, including senior executives, in support of strategic business plans
- In-depth knowledge of the payments industry, including trends, threats, competitors, and regulatory environments relevant to the client segment and region/market
- Ability to lead cross-functional teams through high-impact, complex, or ambiguous business issues without precedent
- Certifications or qualifications in Client/Customer Success, project management, or related disciplines are preferred
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English. Able to convey complex topics in clear, simple terms tailored to the client’s specific use cases.
- Advanced proficiency in the following areas: - Building client relationships: establishing credibility and trust; partnering with clients to grow their business
- Customer centricity: listening to and prioritizing client needs to drive value realization and trusted partnerships
- Success planning: creating measurable action plans to help clients achieve business goals and maximize value from products and solutions
- Client engagement: communicating clearly and effectively with clients at all levels
- Proactiveness: anticipating needs and taking initiative
- Critical thinking: owning and solving complex problems with creative solutions

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Manager, Client Success & Eurozone Operations is a hybrid individual contributor role that combines strategic client engagement with support for key Eurozone priorities. Reporting to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations, the role supports strategic priorities, transformational initiatives and cross-functional programs, helping to ensure the effective execution of operational and business objectives across the Eurozone and contributing to continued compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Alongside these responsibilities, the role serves as a trusted advisor to an assigned portfolio of clients, helping them optimize operational performance, adopt new capabilities and maximize the value of their relationship with Visa.

This role offers broad exposure across European and Global functions, regular interaction with experienced leaders and the opportunity to build capabilities in Client Success, regulatory readiness, strategic execution, transformation and stakeholder management. It is well suited to a high-performing professional who is ready to take ownership within a defined scope and contribute effectively from day one.

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its institute Senckenberg am Meer, German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research in Hamburg, starting as soon as possible

Research Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity

(full time / part-time )

Location: Hamburg

Employment scope: full-time / part-time options available

Type of contract: temporary contract limited until 30.09.2029

Remuneration: collective agreement of the state Hesse, TV-H E13

﻿

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

As part of the institute “Senckenberg am Meer” located in Wilhelmshaven, with its two departments Marine Research and German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research (DZMB), the Hamburg research site, which belongs to the DZMB, focuses on researching taxonomy and systematics of marine life forms.

The position is based within the Zooplankton Working Group and is part of the joint project ZooM-In (Innovative Methods for National Zooplankton Monitoring), contributing to the further development and standardization of modern methods for marine biodiversity monitoring. The project is funded by the Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN) through the National Biodiversity Monitoring Centre’s initiative Sustainable Biodiversity Monitoring.

The project will be carried out in close cooperation with the Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity (HIFMB) as well as federal and state authorities.

Your tasks

- Project management of the project ZooM-In
- Organisation of and participation in monthly expeditions (March-October, 3-4 days per months) to the North Sea
- Organisation of project workshops
- Assessment of zooplankton biodiversity by imaging technologies
- Cross validation of zooplankton biodiversity assessment by traditional microscopy, molecular genetics and imaging methods
- Communication of project results to stakeholders
- Publication of project results in peer-reviewed journals
- Writing of a project report

Your profile

- Master degree in marine biology or natural sciences
- Expertise in the application of plankton imaging technologies (ZooScan and/or PlanktoScope)
- Relevant knowledge on molecular genetic analyses of organisms, ideally metabarcoding of zooplankton
- Experience in data analyses, preferably using R
- Experience with sea-going expeditions on research vessels and sampling of plankton, resilience to motion sickness
- Willingness to participate in interdisciplinary work
- Very good communication skills, ability to work in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary and international environment
- Very good command of English (written and spoken)
- Sound command of the German language is essential for this position

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan
- Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) (as a single PDF, max. 10 MB) on our career pagehttps://www.senckenberg.de/de/karriere/ by 8 November 2026.

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/.

For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung

Senckenberganlage 25

60325 Frankfurt a.M.

If you have any specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Jasmin Renz at jasmin.renz@senckenberg.de.

The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.

The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.

The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).

To strengthen our support for experimental research, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivated

Electronics Engineer (m/f/d)

Your position

As an Electronics Engineer, you will support cutting-edge experimental physics research by developing reliable, high-performance electronic systems in close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff.

- Develop, design and implement analogue and digital electronic systems for experimental physics applications.
- Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust electronic concepts, circuits and complete devices.
- Design, assemble, commission and test printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic instruments, from initial concept through prototyping to deployment in the laboratory.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot and optimise existing electronic systems and measurement equipment.
- Develop firmware for microcontrollers and support the integration of hardware, firmware and software components.
- Work closely with researchers and engineers to provide practical, user-oriented technical solutions for a broad range of experimental setups.
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including circuit diagrams, PCB layouts, assembly instructions and test procedures.
- As the role involves hands-on development, assembly, testing and support of laboratory equipment, regular on-site presence is an essential part of the position.

Your background and skills

- A university degree (Master’s degree or Diplom) in electrical engineering, electronics or a closely related field.
- Sound practical experience in the development of analogue and digital electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout and the assembly, commissioning and testing of electronic devices.
- Proficiency in common ECAD tools for schematic capture and PCB design, ideally including KiCad or Autodesk EAGLE, as well as familiarity with circuit-simulation tools.
- Knowledge of firmware development for microcontrollers, ideally using C/C++. Experience in developing user software for the control, operation and monitoring of electronic devices is also desirable.
- Experience with FPGA development and VHDL is an advantage. Familiarity with CAD systems for mechanical design is also desirable.
- A strong understanding of the requirements and working practices of a diverse scientific and technical environment, combined with intercultural competence and effective communication skills.
- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills.
- Experience in laboratory electronics, measurement technology, scientific instrumentation or experimental physics is desirable.

Our offer

- A varied and responsible position in an international and interdisciplinary scientific environment, with the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative experimental research.
- Close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff on challenging and diverse technical projects.
- A family-friendly working environment with flexible working arrangements, in line with the practical requirements of laboratory-based work.
- Opportunities for professional development and further training.
- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the applicable public-sector collective agreement, depending on qualifications and professional experience.
- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.
- The opportunity to work in a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking research environment.
- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticket

Your application

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all background.

The Max-Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.

To apply please complete the online application form and attach you English CV and motivation letter as well as all relevant certificates latest 15th November, 2026.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact contact Dr. Friedjof Tellkamp by email at friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de) or Dr. Lars Tiemann at lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de (lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de) .

Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter and the online application portal can be found on our website at: https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs (https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs)

We look forward to your application.
